fields.rt-blog-html:
Discover how e-wallets help improve service in institutional food service—whether in school cafeterias, hospitals, or businesses! These solutions are currently being deployed by leading institutional food service companies that manage thousands of locations nationwide. These deployments span a variety of organizational structures, which you can explore in detail in our guide to institutional food service management models.

‍

The Innovorder e-wallet

TheInnovorder e-wallet is an electronic wallet designed to facilitate financial transactions in catering establishments.

The Innovorder e-wallet allows guests to load their e-account with funds directly at the top-up portal, cash desk or top-up kiosk. On their account, guests can view: transactions per order or per day, order channel, order date and time, order number and refunds.

It's a win-win situation for your guests: easier payments and shorter queues.

For you, the manager, the e-wallet simplifies payment management, reduces queues and waiting times, and enables more efficient collection of transaction data and customer consumption habits. It can also be integrated with other restaurant management solutions offered by Innovorder, such as online ordering systems, order kiosks and back-office solutions.

-

Would you like to digitalize your establishment with an e-wallet for your guests? Contact an Innovorder consultant to benefit from their expertise.
